definitions: To have fitted or joined together precisely, like the parts of a feather.
To have turned an oar blade so that it is nearly horizontal as it leaves or enters the water, to reduce wind resistance.
examples: The feathered serpent was a deity.
The arrow was feathered for flight.
The young bird had just feathered.
The carpenter feathered the edges of the planks.
The rower feathered the oar expertly.
